اعتدين (form VIII)
# اِعْتَدَيْنَ (iʕtadayna) /iʕ.ta.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اُعْتُدِينَ (uʕtudīna) /uʕ.tu.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
# اِعْتَدِينَ (iʕtadīna) /iʕ.ta.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِعْتَدَى (iʕtadā)
